decision.reason: [ev-ae9158566d1b] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that some middleware gains Brotli support and points to PR #9387 for details. It doesn't name the middleware or any configuration key, so the subject can't be typed. It also doesn't say whether Brotli is opt-in or used automatically, for example negotiated by default for existing users of that middleware, so applicability and whether existing setups change behaviour can't be decided. To settle this we need the PR, the middleware documentation or a migration-guide excerpt that names the middleware and its options and describes the default behaviour.
